review_notes: I read the whole file and its Defs.lean companion, then searched Mathlib for competing concepts. Prod/Pi torsor instances and the Function.Injective/Surjective.torsor constructors are torsor-specific. Their closest analogues are Prod/Pi MulAction instances and Function.Injective.mulAction. I found no competing duplicate for them. pointReflection lemmas and the Set sdiv lemmas also have no counterpart elsewhere. The one clear issue is constSMulHom, plus constVAddHom. I found no uses of either name elsewhere in Mathlib. constVAddHom uses `Multiplicative G` where the existing AddAction.toPermHom uses `G →+ Additive (Perm P)`. That could be a deliberate orientation, so I did not claim it is strictly redundant. Equiv.constSMul (in Defs.lean, outside the target) also overlaps MulAction.toPerm. Defs.lean is not the target file, so I only mention it as context.

findings.excerpt:
def constSMulHom : G →* Equiv.Perm P where
  toFun v := constSMul P v
  map_one' := constSMul_one G P
  map_mul' := constSMul_mul P
findings.problem: `constSMulHom` is the monoid hom `G →* Equiv.Perm P` sending `v` to the permutation `p ↦ v • p`. Mathlib already has this for any group action as `MulAction.toPermHom G P`, and `Torsor G P` extends `MulAction G P`. The file's `constSMul P v` is also `p ↦ v • p` with inverse `p ↦ v⁻¹ • p`, the same permutation as `MulAction.toPerm v`. `constVAddHom` repeats this for additive groups, but not via `to_additive`. It also uses a different orientation (`Multiplicative G →* Perm P`) from `AddAction.toPermHom` (`G →+ Additive (Perm P)`). The supporting simp lemmas `constSMul_one` and `constSMul_mul` exist only to build these homs, so the torsor file keeps a parallel copy of the `toPermHom` API. I found no uses of `Equiv.constSMulHom` or `Equiv.constVAddHom` elsewhere in Mathlib.
findings.proposed_change: Deprecate `Equiv.constSMulHom` in favour of `MulAction.toPermHom G P`. Alternatively, define it as an abbreviation or alias of that, for example `MulAction.toPermHom G P`, and prove the `constSMul` lemmas by `rfl` or via `map_one`/`map_mul`. Replace `constVAddHom G P` by `(AddAction.toPermHom G P).toMultiplicative`, or deprecate it in favour of `AddAction.toPermHom`. If a `Multiplicative G` version is wanted, it should be derived from the existing hom rather than rebuilt. Then remove or deprecate `constSMul_one` and `constSMul_mul` in favour of `map_one` and `map_mul` on that hom.
findings.benefit: There would be one canonical hom from a group to the permutations of a set it acts on, so `map_pow`, `map_zpow` and injectivity lemmas stated for `MulAction.toPermHom` apply to torsors without conversion. It also removes a non-`to_additive` additive/multiplicative pair whose orientations disagree with the library standard.
